name: subtitles
title_zh: 带时间戳的 YouTube 字幕提取器
tagline_zh: 粘贴链接就拿到逐句字幕，时间戳对齐到秒。翻译、跟读、扒生词都从这开始，不用再对着模糊的自动字幕反复拖进度条。
tagline_en: Paste a link, get line-by-line subtitles with second-level timestamps. Built for translation, shadowing, and.
desc_en: Use when subtitles or the spoken text of a YouTube video is needed: pasted video links or IDs, requests to translate a video, read along, follow foreign-language content, or extract what was said. Also use for language learning or accessibility. Fetches timestamped subtitles from any YouTube video. Not for uploading subtitles or account management.
why_zh: 直接抓取视频自带的时间轴字幕，不是语音转写，所以人名、术语、断句都准。输出结构干净。
why_en: Pulls the official timed text track, not a noisy ASR guess. Clean output that plugs straight into your language-learning or.
limit_zh: 只取已发布的字幕轨，无字幕或仅自动生成（未经作者确认）的视频可能拿不到；不做翻译、不做单词卡，只给带时间戳的原文。
limit_en: Only works on videos with an existing subtitle track; auto-captions may be missing. No translation or flashcard generation—just timestamped raw text.
title_en: Timestamped subtitle extractor for any YouTube video
